name: Chiss fighter
description: Chiss fighters were starfighters used by the Chiss Ascendancy's Picket Force Two. It is grey and built in a curved, flowing design. It is about the size of a shuttle or heavy fighter.

data.name: Chiss fighter
data.length: Between X-wing starfighter and GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat
data.armament: Conner Nets and Maser type beam weapons
